data.narrative:
MBRYONICS is a Series B aerospace & space company that has raised €17.5M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of four private peers in the same sector at Series B/C stages (Sierra Space at $8.0B, Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B, Aalyria at $1.3B, and Skyryse at $1.1B), alongside five public Space & Aerospace benchmarks (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two valuation methods apply directly. Stage-progression analysis uses the €17.5M raised as a proxy for current valuation, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $33M. Peer-median methodology across the four same-sector comparables produces a $1.6B median valuation, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of revenue disclosure for MBRYONICS. Public Space & Aerospace peers trade at a 24.4x price-to-sales median, but this method requires target revenue data unavailable for private companies.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $28M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $842M. The wide dispersion reflects substantial uncertainty around MBRYONICS' technical maturity, revenue trajectory, and competitive positioning relative to peers. Stage-progression yields a floor estimate grounded in capital deployed; peer-median reflects the significant valuation spread within the aerospace sector and MBRYONICS' differentiation or burn profile relative to comparables.
